about: One command script for every host (iteration 23c): the state machine with a fake clock (crates/saturnus-drive/tests/protocol_script.rs), the native runner (same file; its replies and events travel apart, so the events in order and the replies by step) and the Web Worker with the real wasm (web/test/protocol-script.test.mjs) each run it on a 48SX with a ROM of zeros (it computes forever and never sleeps or draws) and must give the transcript in protocol-script.expected.json: every event and reply in order, a reply as {reply: step, ok, result | error}. A step's msg gets v: 1 unless it has a v; noId sends it without an id; pipe sends the next step without waiting for this one's reply (no timer fires in between), the next step without pipe waits for all; rom: zeros boots 256 KiB of zeros named zeros (the Worker as bytes, the runner as a file); state: saved loads the last saveState's state; any lists result fields that differ by host or run, written as *.
